1) CHARACTER: Light-brown ash-blonde hair in loose low bun with wooden hair stick, long face-framing strands; gray-hazel eyes; fair skin; freckles across nose/cheeks and upper chest/shoulders; small smile, no fangs; no visible marks beyond freckles and green moss-like smudges.
2) CLOTHING STATE: Purple loose off-shoulder dress (neckline at mid-chest, sleeves slipped off shoulders) + dark purple shawl/robe draped over both arms/shoulders + large mushroom-covered witch hat + green beaded choker. Covered: chest, stomach, hips, thighs (mostly out of frame). Uncovered: shoulders, upper chest/collarbone, neck, arms below shoulder. No nipple shapes or under-fabric detail visible; fabric is opaque.
3) POSE: Standing, torso angled slightly, head tilted down-left toward viewer's right. Arms lowered, forearms/hands not visible (out of frame at bottom). Legs not visible.
4) CAMERA: Upper-body/portrait crop (hat to mid-torso); slightly low angle, mild clockwise tilt (subtle dutch); subject faces viewer right of center.
5) SCENE: Interior with large round window behind, rain streaks outside; constellation line-and-dot graphics overlaid; mushrooms growing on hat/shawl; soft cool blue-violet ambient light, rim/backlight from window, glowing cyan accent lights.
6) RATING VERDICT: PG-13 — chest fully covered by opaque fabric, no erotic emphasis or suggestive framing.
7) ACID/LSD THEME: Yes — hallucinogenic-forest motif: luminous mushrooms covering hat and garment, floating constellation nodes, bioluminescent cyan glow, moss smudges on skin/fabric; but no kaleidoscope/prism/melting-color effects; reads "enchanted/mystic" more than explicit acid-trip.
